text:
Counting the grapes on the plate gives about 24: roughly 22 red or dark and 2 green.

Each grape looks fairly small to medium, so I assumed about 3-4 g apiece. Some of the red ones look slightly oblong and larger, so I used an average of 3.5 g.

Total mass: 24 × 3.5 g ≈ 84 g.

Grapes provide about 0.69 kcal per gram, so 84 g × 0.69 ≈ 58 kcal.
